'''Mike Tomashewski''' (also listed as '''Michael Tomashewski'''; forum handle '''Shewski''')<ref name="shewski-handle">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-mike-tomashewski-ls-profit/ 2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event Mike Tomashewski LS Profit], starwarsccg.org (22 October 2014): "Mike Tomashewski (Shewski)". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012184159/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-mike-tomashewski-ls-profit.html Internet Archive]; [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22347 Preregistration List], forum.starwarsccg.org: "Mike Tomashewski - PA Shewski". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012213614/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22347.html Internet Archive].</ref> played the [[2015 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ 2015 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> On 20 August 2008 he posted "the text of v16 as current for today", for [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith|Virtual Set 16]], on the Players Committee forum board of [sw-ip], the SW:CCG Information Pool.<ref name="pcf-22693-329092">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=329092#329092 txt file], Mike Tomashewski (Shewski), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080910182704/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=329092&sid=53796e9b903b883c6cbd7d70c1579a84 Internet Archive]</ref> He published constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]] as Shewski.

== Card credits ==
Mike Tomashewski is credited with the original concept of two Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: PC Volunteer Award 2006. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 1]] (cards first released 2002–2009) and [[Virtual Block 6]] (released 2009–2010).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Look Sir, Droids (V)]] || [[Virtual Block 1]] || 2002–2009 || "Original concept by Mike Tomashewski, PC Volunteer Award 2006"
|-
| [[Scomp Link Access (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Scomp Link Access (V)]] || [[Virtual Block 6]] || 2009–2010 || "Original concept by Mike Tomashewski, PC Volunteer Award 2006"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Mike Tomashewski|Mike Tomashewski]] on [[Card Credits]].
